Beginning_cash is the governmental funds' beginning fund balance 2,117,155 (modified cash: fund balance equals total assets of cash, CDs and investments); ending_cash is total governmental assets 1,802,471 (cash 1,285,757, certificates of deposit 35,163, investments 463,971, county treasurer cash 17,580; p5); investment fields left null since investments are already inside cash. Transfers_in is the printed net 'Transfers in (out)' 11,232 (General +25,191, Street +4,066, Sinking -18,025); Electric Fund transfer out 11,232 (p9) matches. 'Public works' 178,533 includes cemetery 27,147. Business-type from the Proprietary Funds Total column (p9); business net position 3,218,366 + 1,654,348 - 1,589,640 - 11,232 = 3,271,842. Proprietary statement of cash flows total column (p11) not recorded since basis is not GAAP; operating 299,380, noncapital -11,232, capital -134,504, investing 44,676. Detail: General Fund recorded from the General Fund Departments schedule (p18-19, more detailed) rather than the p12 budget schedule (not double counted; budget_final null; p12 budget shows Administrative 88,076 and Northwest Village 490,340 etc.). Street, Sinking and Library Memorial from their budget schedules (pp13-15); nonmajor funds from the combining statement (pp16-17), per fund. Zero ('-') lines skipped. Proprietary fund columns (Electric/Water/Sewer/Sanitation, pp8-11) not entered in detail. Cemetery function set to health/welfare in detail although the village prints it under public works.
